verdict: No remaining blocking correctness findings in the authorized operation-stream gzip, batching, and Sites header scope.
source_review: RFC 9110 Accept-Encoding negotiation handles repeated field lines, case-insensitive gzip/identity tokens, q=0, wildcard fallback, explicit identity preference/refusal, malformed weights, and conflicting duplicates conservatively. Positive gzip is selected when identity is only implicit; unsupported acceptable codings alone do not enable gzip. 406 occurs before public-limit admission when both supported representations are refused.

Gzip uses level 1 and a single member. The first binding and each available-frame batch are flushed with Z_SYNC_FLUSH for incremental decompression; normal completion sends Z_FINISH. Decoded canonical NDJSON bytes, line order, frame payloads, and operation hashes are preserved.

Batches drain only already-available frames, capped at 64KiB and 10ms drain time; a larger accepted frame stands alone. Producer checks and original 2MiB per-frame, 8-frame/2MiB waiting-data limits remain in force. Non-fitting lookahead retains both byte and logical frame charges until consumed. Existing runtime MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES=24MiB and MAX_SECONDS=10 remain unchanged.

Disconnect now sets cancellation before a gzip footer can be yielded. Explicit iterator close and cancellation run the single stream generator cleanup; no nested iterator wrapper requires separate close propagation.

Sites forwards Accept-Encoding only for operation paths, passes the native unread origin stream through with Content-Encoding and Vary retained, and retains existing no-store, credential filtering, and public read-only behavior. The exact response-body pattern is documented by Cloudflare Fetch passthrough guidance.

coverage: identity and gzip iterator aclose after first binding
identity and gzip disconnect cancels before next footer yield
identity and gzip explicit task cancellation
identity and gzip non-fitting lookahead preserves aggregate waiting-byte bound

writer_validation_evidence.note: Inspected existing writer evidence; did not independently repeat the broader affected-module runs.

resolved_findings.issue: Gzip disconnect footer could precede worker cancellation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Cancellation is set immediately on detected disconnect before footer generation.

resolved_findings.issue: Non-fitting lookahead was uncharged while still waiting, allowing another 1.3MB checkpoint to queue alongside a pending 1.3MB checkpoint.
resolved_findings.resolution: Lookahead retains byte and logical frame charges until entering the next batch.

known_limits: Native Cloudflare Workers execution and public deployed transport were not run. Node mocks verify forwarding/preservation; official Cloudflare documentation supplies the native passthrough contract.
The existing 10-second bound is cooperative computation/producer/consumer behavior. It is not an absolute client-download or stalled-ASGI-send timer; this patch adds no send watchdog.
No full suite, release/source seal, browser review, deployment, production journal access, paid inference, backend semantics change, or public product network request was performed by this reviewer.
scratch_harness_note: An initial scratch-only run failed because its fake service omitted a store attribute; adding that fixture attribute fixed the harness. This was not a product finding. The later lookahead red run was a real source regression and is resolved above.
